name: lazyfinder-sidebar-divider
criterio: order 2026-10-13-06 point 1, as corrected by Mathias: Favorites and Locations are two boxes, each with its own border and title, like Folders, Tasks and Tags in lazymark (not a line between them)

steps.desc: Favorites is a box with its own top border and title
Locations is a second box with its own top border and title
the Favorites box closes before the Locations box opens
no line of dashes between them, and no single Places box
the box border has the border color of the theme
a click on a place in the Locations box opens it
while the sidebar has the focus, the box holding the selection takes the focus color
